description: Generate expert multi-strategy Boolean patent-search queries from a natural-language description. The server (1) extracts technical concepts with synonyms and (2) builds Boolean queries per the chosen strategy, returning them for you to run against your full-text patent engine (e.g. Google Patents). Results are not executed server-side on this API tier (clean USPTO-only surface, no scraping) — run the returned `queries`, or use the `query` tool for a single optimized query. Strategies: 'telescoping' (3 queries: broad/moderate/narrow — recommended default), 'onion-ring' (layered queries adding one concept at a time), 'faceted' (multiple two-concept pair queries). Costs 1 credit.

description.description: Natural-language description of the invention or technology area (minimum 10 characters).

limit.description: Maximum number of deduplicated hits to return (default 20, max 100).

name: search

executionMode.description: 'client_side' = run the returned queries yourself (API tier); 'server_side' = hits included.

hits.description: Ranked patent hits (only when executed server-side; empty on the client_side API tier).

note.description: Guidance on how to use the returned queries.

queries.description: Boolean queries run with labels and hit counts.

warnings.description: Optional warnings from the search run.
